text: {"lessons":["I should judge each trade by the stock’s current outlook and the portfolio’s risk, not by my average cost or the discomfort of realizing a loss.","I should use consistent position limits and reassess concentration as prices move; repeated purchases can add risk even when each trade seems modest.","I should follow a planned approach to both winners and losers rather than selling winners for the satisfaction of locking in gains while delaying decisions on losing positions."]}
